title: Deduplicate the MockNotificationGateway class shared verbatim by notifications_screen_test.dart and ws5_two_layers_test.dart

evidence.quote: class MockNotificationGateway extends Mock implements NotificationGateway {}
class MockNotificationGateway extends Mock implements NotificationGateway {}

why: Two files under the same feature independently declare an identical top-level `MockNotificationGateway` class. Harmless today, but the digest's dedup pass will flag it as a duplicate top-level symbol, and if the two copies ever drift (e.g. one gets extra default stubs), the same name means different behavior depending on which file's test you're reading.
recommendation: Move the class into a small shared test-support file under test/features/notifications/ (e.g. support/mock_notification_gateway.dart) and import it from both.
acceptance_criteria: Only one MockNotificationGateway declaration exists; both test files import it.
(Rule-0, Pending) AG-4 duplicate-symbol audit no longer lists MockNotificationGateway as duplicated.
